# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes apply to the current `main` branch. Older commits and archived branches do not receive security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/VPN-Subcription-Links/ClashX-V2Ray-TopFreeProxy/security/advisories/new) to report vulnerabilities privately. Include affected files or commits, reproduction steps, and the potential impact. Do not include passwords, tokens, or private subscription links unless necessary to reproduce the issue.

Do not disclose unpatched vulnerabilities in public issues or pull requests.

## Scope

This policy covers this repository's code, dependencies, and workflows. Report vulnerabilities in third-party nodes, subscription providers, or client applications to their respective maintainers. Broken subscriptions and ordinary setup problems belong in repository issues.

## Response and Disclosure

Maintainers review reports, coordinate fixes, and agree on disclosure with the reporter. No fixed response or resolution deadline is guaranteed.

# 安全政策

## 支持范围

安全修复仅适用于当前 `main` 分支。旧提交及归档分支不接收安全更新。

## 漏洞报告

请通过 [GitHub 私密漏洞报告](https://github.com/VPN-Subcription-Links/ClashX-V2Ray-TopFreeProxy/security/advisories/new) 私下报告漏洞，并提供受影响的文件或提交、复现步骤及潜在影响。除非复现问题确有必要，请勿附上密码、令牌或私人订阅链接。

请勿在公开 Issue 或 Pull Request 中披露尚未修复的漏洞。

## 适用范围

本政策涵盖本仓库的代码、依赖及自动化工作流。第三方节点、订阅提供方或客户端软件的漏洞，请向其维护者报告。订阅失效及一般设置问题请通过仓库 Issue 反馈。

## 响应与披露

维护者会审阅报告、协调修复，并与报告者协商披露事宜。不保证固定的响应或解决期限。
